title: tragacantha bachtiarica
intro: Tragacantha bachtiarica, commonly known as Dhamasa, is a plant species in the Celastraceae family, traditionally used in Iranian folk medicine. The plant is known for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha bachtiarica include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, as well as its potential to treat various health conditions, such as diabetes and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Tragacantha bachtiarica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
